title: Implement a function under explicit constraints
prompt: Implement the `render(obj)` function in `render.js` so that `node --test` passes. `render(obj)` must return the object's entries as `KEY=VALUE` lines joined by newlines, with keys sorted in ascending order and no trailing newline. You MUST build each line using `formatPair` and sort keys using `compareKeys`, both imported from `./frozen.js`. STRICT CONSTRAINTS (all enforced by the verifier): (1) Do NOT modify `frozen.js` in any way — it is a public contract. (2) Do NOT use any asynchronous code in `render.js` — no `async`, `await`, `.then`, or `Promise`. (3) Do NOT introduce module-level mutable state in `render.js` — no top-level `let` or `var` (module-level `const` is fine; local variables inside functions are fine). (4) Do NOT modify the test file. Edit only `render.js`.
